verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe dozens of prebuilt connectors covering shopping carts and billing systems. You authorize a platform once from Data Sources > Connect, and Kintsugi keeps transactions in sync after that, so you don't build the plumbing yourself. The evidence is vendor-only and general rather than per-connector. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of payment processors, a named list of supported platforms or per-connector documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors are maintained and sync reliably.
